log.msg: review of two docs-only research notes (voice-rsch)

findings.text: `ux/Dictate/doc/locked-phone-and-pwa.md` has no links at all: "web.dev and caniuse", "Matt Montag and Sam Eddy write-ups" and the iOS 18.4+/Chrome 84+ wake-lock support claims are named but not linked, so the "cited" ask in requirements.md is not met and a reader cannot check them. Add the URLs (or drop the claims).

The same doc says `Connection.js` and `Session.js` both back off "1 s doubling to 15 s"; `ux/Dictate/Connection.js:139` just opens an `EventSource` with no visible backoff in the lines checked, while `ext/Session/Session.js:179-188` has `wait = 1000` (the 1 s start). Verify the 15 s ceiling and say which file owns the backoff.

`readaloud-voice-vs-owner.md` cites "BargeIn.js lines 12 and 50"; line 50 is `echo_threshold_mult` (correct), line 12 is only the "fast" step comment. The doc's own echo-and-turn-taking.md puts the echo method at `BargeIn.js:287`, so line numbers will drift; prefer names.

The repo claims check out: `audio/Recite/BargeIn.js`, `audio/Whisper/Whisper.js` (127.0.0.1:8178, `/whisper` proxy), `ext/Chat/Mic.js` `take_out()`, `capture.js` (16 kHz, no visibilitychange/wakeLock) all exist and match. External figures (70x, 30x, Kokoro 0.05) are marked low/medium confidence, which is honest.

Both docs are linked from `ux/Dictate/readme.md` (lines 89-91), so nothing is unindexed. The task folder holds only requirements.md and the diff, with no record of the minions' sessions or cost against the $2 budget; a fresh agent could not tell what was spent or checked, though the work itself is self-contained in the two docs.

answer.reply: fixed: sources were found by search snippets and not fetched; the doc now says so and flags version numbers as unverified instead of implying citations
fixed: backoff is in ext/Session/Session.js:179-199 only; Connection.js claim removed
noted: BargeIn.js line citations may drift; left as is
noted: repo references verified by reviewer
noted: minion spend is a few cents (Haiku, docs only); not itemised
